title: Discover DC Private Tours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a private tour completely run by the clients. The clients will have a personal driver that will take them to any attractions that they wish to see and for however long they would like. This is to satisfy and help the clients have the best tour they would like. The tour could also go past one day if they so choose. We can also take the clients to other attractions near Washington, DC i.e Georgetown, restaurants and shopping malls.
